Operational description

The electronic control units that communicate via the CAN exchange information by means of the body computer node M001.

The body computer node receives a direct battery supply at pin 1 connector A and an ignition-operated supply at pin 1 connector L.

From connector O, the body computer node receives/sends signals coming:

  • from the radio receiver node M094, pin 1, 3 connector A;
  • from the climate control system control unit M070, pin 9, 10 connector B.

From connector O, the body computer node receives/sends signals coming:

  • from the electric steering control unit M086, pin 5, 10 connector B;
  • from the engine management control unit M010, pin 6 and 32 connector B.

From connector I the body computer node receives/sends the signals coming from the instrument panel E050, pin 8,9 connector A.

From connector H the body computer node receives/sends the signals to the diagnostic socket R010, pin 6, 14.
